en.description: A bold toggle above a text sample: pressing it restyles the sample at once, so it reads as an action on an object rather than a form setting.
en.docs: One file, zero dependencies, its own --vibeui-toggle-001-* palette. Client-side: the state is held by useState. The button declares its state through aria-pressed rather than checked: a toggle is an immediate action on a view or an object (make the selection bold), a switch is a setting that turns a mode on, and a checkbox is a form field that travels to the server on submit. The pressed look is picked by the selector button[aria-pressed="true"], so the markup and the style cannot drift apart. The sample text sits beside it and receives font-weight through data-bold on the root — the effect is visible the same instant.

en.description: A toggle with an icon and a stable caption: the caption stays the name of the action, and the result is announced by a live line under the button.
en.docs: One file, zero dependencies, the --vibeui-toggle-002-* palette. Client-side: useState. The button caption does not change when pressed — only aria-pressed and the live role="status" line under it change. That is a deliberate decision: the caption is the button's name, and if it were rewritten to "Unpin", a screen reader would read the new name together with the state and produce "Unpin, pressed". The pressed state is shown by three cues at once — the filled icon (fill:currentColor on the path), the background and the word in the line — because one colour is not read by everyone. Unlike a switch, the action applies instantly and to a specific object.

en.description: A favourite button with a counter: the star fills in, the number next to it updates instantly, and the counter itself stays out of the button's name.

This is a toggle, not a checkbox: the favourite changes at once and belongs to the object, not to a form field.

items.description: Toggle «показать сетку»: кнопка связана с холстом через aria-controls, а сетка включается отдельным слоем поверх макета и ничего в нём не двигает.

Кнопка объявляет aria-controls на холст — так связь «кнопка → область» есть не только в голове автора. Сетка нарисована двумя linear-gradient на отдельном слое с pointer-events:none и включается прозрачностью, поэтому макет под ней не перерисовывается и не дёргается. en.description: A "show grid" toggle: the button is tied to the canvas through aria-controls, and the grid switches on as a separate layer above the layout without moving anything.
en.docs: One file, zero dependencies, the --vibeui-toggle-004-* palette. Client-side: useState and useId. The button declares aria-controls on the canvas — that way the button-to-region link exists somewhere other than the author's head. The grid is drawn with two linear-gradients on a separate layer with pointer-events:none and is switched on by opacity, so the layout beneath it is not repainted and does not jump. The cell step arrives in the step prop and goes out into the CSS variable --vibeui-toggle-004-step inline — it is a dynamic value and cannot be expressed by a class. A toggle, not a switch: the view changes here and now.

en.docs: One file, zero dependencies, the --vibeui-toggle-005-* palette. Client-side: useState. the icon rotation as the primary state cue — it reads without perceiving colour
the whole row's background highlight through data-pinned, not just the button colour
aria-pressed as the source of both state and look: they cannot drift apart
swapping the second line for a pinned status through role="status"
the visible focus ring on the button: it is used from the keyboard
light-dark() in the palette: the component has to follow the surrounding color-scheme rather than ship a dark theme of its own
the transparent background by default — the component sits on the page background instead of laying a panel under itself
adapt: the note text in the default state through note
the note text in the pinned state through pinnedNote
the button action names through actionText
background — the component background; empty means no background, taking the page colour
notes: The theme comes from color-scheme. For the component to darken with the system, the project must declare color-scheme: light dark on html — otherwise light-dark() always returns the light branch.
The rotation is a toggle, an instant action on the row, not a setting queued behind a Save button.
Do not drop the background highlight: rotation alone may not be enough for low colour perception.
Do not make the button's aria-label static — "Pin" and "Unpin" must describe the next action.
Do not lift the CSS variables into globals.css: the component has to stay a single file.
ai.usage:
<Toggle014
  title="Monthly expense report"
  note="Updated yesterday"
  defaultPressed={false}
/>

pinnedNote.label: Pinned note
pinnedNote.default: Pinned to the top of the list
